info.about: Star Ocean is a 1996 action role-playing game developed by tri-Ace and published by Enix for the Super Famicom. The first game in the Star Ocean series, it was released only in Japan in July 1996, and was the first game developed by tri-Ace, consisting of staff that had previously left Wolf Team due to being unhappy with the development process for Tales of Phantasia with Namco in 1995.
info.trivia: The first Western release of the original Star Ocean, remade in the Second Story engine.
info.why: Moderate supply, and a 2019 remaster gives players another route, so prices are mid-range.
